description: No clean concept found. Weak, diffuse tendency: fires more in early, sparse positions where the center column is built up (my stone in its third cell, row 2), column 4 (right of center) is empty, and the opponent has stones low on the left while I do not. Many firing positions lack this pattern (even an empty center), so treat it as a loose lean, not a rule.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most about 0.06, mostly 0.00 (9 positions).
notes: 5 score calls. Best dev F1 0.117 (P 0.107, R 0.130, AUROC 0.61), sim share 0.05. Single-cell (2,3)-mine/(1,3)-theirs rule AUROC 0.53. Minimal pairs show context-dependent, mirror-asymmetric effects (col 4 stones and my left-side stones suppress; their bottom-left stones raise), activation alternates by ply within a game. No steer effect. Likely a diffuse or random direction. Synthesis 3.391 beats dev max 3.284.
